title: 2026 GB F-gas quota application-window QA controls

sources.title: Applying for quota to produce or import F gas
Fluorinated gas (F gas): guidance for users, producers and traders

facts.source_fact: Quota is required to produce or import bulk HFCs into Great Britain when the quota rules apply.
Quota is expressed in equivalent tonnes of CO2.
The annual quota application window runs from 30 June to 31 August.
Quota must be obtained before covered HFCs are placed on the GB market.
New entrants can apply when first producing or importing 100 tCO2e or more in a year.
Equipment importers and authorisation managers cannot apply for bulk quota as those roles; they obtain authorisations instead.
An F-gas account is required before applying.
GB HFC phase-down policy is separate from any single operator's actual emissions.
New entrant allocation is communicated by the end of December according to the guidance.
The guidance was last updated 3 June 2026; use that version context for this QA package.
